value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto looks warm but wet. Expect showers and a chance of thunderstorms, mostly in the morning and afternoon, with highs around 24 to 25°C, feeling closer to 30 with the humidity. Gusty southwest wind near noon, and rain could total 10 to 20 mm, so an umbrella is a good idea. It should ease up by Wednesday, with a mix of sun and cloud and a 30% chance of showers.
